PARISHWIDE COUNCIL PROPOSITION
(SALES TAX RENEWAL)

contests.summary:
CITY OF MORGAN CITY HOME RULE CHARTER AMENDMENT
PROPOSITION NO. 1

ELECTING A MAYOR PRO TEMPORE

SUMMARY:  THE FOLLOWING PROPOSITION WOULD AMEND SECTION 2-06(g) OF THE MORGAN CITY HOME RULE CHARTER, EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY, AND THEREBY PROVIDE THAT THE MAYOR PRO TEMPORE SHALL BE ELECTED BY A MAJORITY VOTE OF THE FIVE (5) MEMBER COUNCIL AT THE 1ST REGULARLY SCHEDULED JANUARY MEETING OF THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE CITY EACH YEAR AND THAT THE MAYOR PRO TEMPORE SHALL SERVE IN THAT CAPACITY UNTIL THE FOLLOWING JANUARY MEETING WHEN A NEW MAYOR PRO TEMPORE SHALL BE SELECTED BY A MAJORITY VOTE.

contests.title: City of Morgan City HRC -- Prop #2 Mosquito Abatement Fee -- M & Council
contests.summary:
CITY OF MORGAN CITY HOME RULE CHARTER AMENDMENT
PROPOSITION NO. 2

MOSQUITO ABATEMENT FEE

SUMMARY:  THE FOLLOWING PROPOSITION WOULD ADD SECTION 5-11 TO THE MORGAN CITY HOME RULE CHARTER, EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY, TO AUTHORIZE THE COUNCIL TO PLACE A CHARGE OR FEE FOR MOSQUITO ABATEMENT ON THE UTILITY BILLS OF EACH AND EVERY PERSON, CORPORATION OR OTHER ENTITY RECEIVING UTILITY SERVICES FROM THE CITY OF MORGAN CITY.
